metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare NDVI around Windhoek, Namibia for February 2021 vs the 2010-2020 average for February. I need to: 1. Define the location (Windhoek, Namibia) - I'll use a point with buffer 2. Use appropriate satellite data - MODIS vegetation indices (MOD13Q1) would be good for consistent NDVI time series 3. Get February 2021 NDVI and calculate the 2010-2020 February average 4. Compare the values and determine if 2021 was higher I need to handle: - Data availability checks (if no images found, try alternatives) - Valid pixel counts - Proper NDVI range validation (-1 to 1) - Clear output with evidence Let me structure this: - Use MOD13Q1.061 (Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day Global 250m) - Filter for February months only - Calculate mean NDVI for 2021 and 2010-2020 period - Compare and output result ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.0832, -22.5700]); // Windhoek coordinates const region = windhoek.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Windhoek // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Vegetation Indices const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1'); // Function to get February NDVI for a specific year function getFebNDVI(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1); // Feb 1 const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'month'); // Mar 1 return modisCol .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('NDVI') .mean() .multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor for MODIS NDVI } // Get 2021 NDVI const ndvi2021 = getFebNDVI(2021); // Get 2010-2020 average NDVI const years = ee.List.sequence(2010, 2020); const historicalNDVI = years.map(year => getFebNDVI(year)); const avgHistorical = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(historicalNDVI).mean(); // Check data availability const count2021 = modisCol.filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-03-01').size(); const countHistorical = modisCol.filterDate('2010-02-01', '2021-02-01') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month')).size(); // February only const count2021Info = count2021.getInfo(); const countHistoricalInfo = countHistorical.getInfo(); print(`2021 February images: ${count2021Info}`); print(`2010-2020 February images: ${countHistoricalInfo}`); if (count2021Info === 0 || countHistoricalInfo === 0) { print("C1: Empty Collection"); return; } // Calculate regional means const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const statsHistorical = avgHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndvi2021Val = stats2021.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndviHistoricalVal = statsHistorical.get('NDVI').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (ndvi2021Val === null || ndviHistoricalVal === null) { print("C2: No Valid Pixels"); return; } // Validate NDVI range if (Math.abs(ndvi2021Val) > 1 || Math.abs(ndviHistoricalVal) > 1 || isNaN(ndvi2021Val) || isNaN(ndviHistoricalVal)) { print("C3: Calculation Failure"); return; } // Print evidence and determine answer print(`2021 Feb NDVI: ${ndvi2021Val.toFixed(3)}`); print(`2010-2020 Avg Feb NDVI: ${ndviHistoricalVal.toFixed(3)}`); print(`Difference: ${(ndvi2021Val - ndviHistoricalVal).toFixed(3)}`); if (ndvi2021Val > ndviHistoricalVal) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
